attachment_asset_link_valid.name: attachment_asset_link_valid
attachment_asset_link_valid.value: "attachment"."asset_id" is null or ("attachment"."message_id" is null and "attachment"."channel_id" is null and "attachment"."linked_at" is not null)

ban_appeal_resolution.name: ban_appeal_resolution
ban_appeal_resolution.value: ("ban_appeal"."resolved_at" is null and "ban_appeal"."resolution" is null) or ("ban_appeal"."resolved_at" is not null and "ban_appeal"."resolution" in ('uphold', 'unban'))

voice_call_status.name: voice_call_status
voice_call_status.value: ("voice_call"."status" = 'active' and "voice_call"."closed_at" is null) or ("voice_call"."status" = 'closed' and "voice_call"."closed_at" is not null)

voice_member_state.name: voice_member_state
voice_member_state.value: ("voice_call_member"."state" in ('waiting', 'active') and "voice_call_member"."left_at" is null) or ("voice_call_member"."state" = 'left' and "voice_call_member"."left_at" is not null)
